notes.title: A-Tech Cybernetic Update - Index Controller support & complete 'Swarm' overhaul!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, 

A-Tech Cybernetic’s full release is getting closer and closer - this update is probably one of the last steps before we consider the game finished. 

INDEX CONTROLLER SUPPORT

We have added proper Index Controller support (finger tracking not included). We've tried to make the most comfortable and practical layout possible.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28133510/f3bcaded30e88fb015f1c48cebc8b4401c3bac1c.jpg

SWARM MODE OVERHAUL

We have also completely overhauled the 'Swarm' mode of the game. We took extreme care while rebalancing each wave - as a result, the difficulty curve now increases gradually and makes playing 'Swarm' more challenging, and more rewarding. 

We have also added a new level: 'Reactor' - and removed one: 'Cave'. 
The 'Cave' level wasn't up to our optimization and quality standards, it would've taken more time to fix it than to add a completely new one, so we went with the latter option. 

Another new balancing feature is the way weapons unlock - they now become available in a pre-defined order in every wave.
Weapon spawning has also changed - on easy, normal and hard difficulties, picked-up weapons respawn after 10, 15 and 30 seconds respectively.

These changes mean that the 'Swarm' mode as a whole became more balanced, but more challenging at the same time. 
Giving it another shot is recommended even for seasoned A-Tech players! :)

ACHIEVEMENT UNLOCK SYSTEM

We've fixed the achievement unlock system, every achievement should now count correctly and should work as intended overall. 

---

That's all for now. If you encounter any issues, please let us know either below this post, in the community hub or via Discord. 
We see everything, even if we don't respond immediately. :) 

Thank you guys for your continuous support! 
-XREAL Games Team-

notes.title: A-Tech Cybernetic Content Update - Two new Chapters, fixes & improvements!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, 

This is it.. The long awaited content update is here!
The  two brand new Chapters, Chapter 05 - The Sundering and Chapter 06 - The End  brings an epic closure to A-Tech Cybernetic’s story. 
We’ve overhauled the gameplay and combat intensity throughout the whole game - in return, it became much more challenging!  You really have to break a sweat in order to survive each Chapter. 

Besides adding new content, we’ve fixed countless community-reported issues and made improvements on all aspects of the game. 
You can check all the fixes and improvements in the patch notes below.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28133510/f06d687d37d213146934a2af93be88f95d170d54.jpg

GENERAL AI FIXES AND IMPROVEMENTS

 Improved Brute behavior.
 Improved accuracy and behavior for armed enemies -  as a result, the game became a tiiiny bit more difficult. 
 Various other fixes for armed enemies.
 Fixed a crash caused by zombies exploding.
 Fixed an issue with enemies changing colour before dissolving.
 General improvement of enemy performance and behavior.
 Polished enemy animations.


GAMEPLAY RELATED FIXES AND IMPROVEMENTS

 Improved accessibility: a left-handed control layout has been added.
 Improved locomotion.
 Vive controller teleport fix: in turning mode, teleport is only activated by hitting UP on the touchpad. No more accidental teleporting while turning.
 Fixed a rare bug where the player could’ve gotten stuck when dying during hand scanning.
 Fixed the menu laser pointer.
 Revised checkpoints.
 New safety timers for objective triggers.
 Fixed teleports.
 Updated enemy encounters.
 Fixed an issue where the detonator didn’t disappear after the explosion.
 Improved navigation.
 Fixed a locomotion issue when playing while sitting down, or being really short.
 Fixed tutorial controllers not attaching to the player’s hand properly on the menu level.
 Temporary fix for players not being able to pick up weapon ammo during later chapters (if they skipped previous chapters) 
 The flashlight can not be dropped accidentally.
 Melee weapons can be stored (one at a time).
 Fixed flamethrower.
 Fixed ladder static component.
 Weapon projectiles are now unaffected by gravity.
 General sound mix balance update.
 Updated objective markers.
 Updated chapter 2 “hangar fight” enemy encounter.


PERFORMANCE OPTIMIZATION

 Various skeletal meshes have been converted to static meshes.
 Fixed memory leak issue in Chapter 03: unused particles are removed.
 Updated level streaming.
 Added splash screen and credit roll.


 KNOWN ISSUES 

 Achievements are WiP, might not be unlocking correctly, or at all. 
 The “turn music off” option is not yet implemented in the menus.
 There is a rare issue with HTC Vive headset audio output that might cause crashes. If this happens, connect your ear/headphones directly to the PC and set your audio device to the PC audio output port instead of the Vive.
 Swarm mode is under development, will be reworked in the next update.

--- 

That’s all for now. 
This update is an important step towards the game’s Full Release this year, so if you encounter any issues, or just want to share your feedback with us, please head over to the game’s community hub, or to our Discord server. 
 We read everything, even if we don’t respond. :) 

Thank you for the continuous support!
XREAL Games Team

notes.title: A-Tech Cybernetic devblog - Breaking the silence: new update coming soon™!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, 

Long time no see! 
In this news post i will shed some light on A-Tech Cybernetic's development and the content of the long awaited, upcoming update. You can check the preliminary patch notes at the end of this post. 

3 years ago, our small indie team consisting of talented VR enthusiasts started working on A-Tech Cybernetic. As it was the team's first VR project, one could say that this was also a learning project. But an ambitious one at that. 
The development went great, the team started growing and another project emerged from our developer's minds. 

A team within the team started working on the new project, while the original A-Tech team continued the game's development. 
Around this time last year, the team went further and dreamt bigger: why lock the game to PC and leave other platforms out of the fun? 
And so happened that we've started exploring yet another completely unknown realm: PSVR. 
We knew porting it was going to be difficult, but started it anyway because at the time we could easily manage a parallel development. Or so we thought.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28133510/5115f543b17898ad2cbf402e6a23859da26511df.jpg

I've mentioned it a few times that in order to have a successfull port, we had to develop both versions simultaneously (or even from scratch).

Long story short, technical difficulties arose (quite a few) which meant that we had to delay the PC version's update further and further. 
We know this isn't how it should've happened, and we apologize for that. It was a valuable lesson for XREAL Games, all our current and future endevours will benefit from our experiences. :)

And now, for the update itself. A ton of things will be fixed/optimized, left handed support is coming, as are two brand new Chapters: 05 - The Sundering and 06 - The End, the latter bringing the story to a closure.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28133510/f06d687d37d213146934a2af93be88f95d170d54.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28133510/f2d83028f8fbad899c9062a4f8ee252c26c6d09b.jpg

notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28133510/b1c70640a8500c4ae2e39f6f0604785ae77435d5.jpg
Hi A-Tech Fans,
 
Our latest major Update (v0.14.0) is officially out now!
We have added new stuff, fixed a lot of bugs, fine-tuned the gameplay, optimized performance and so on. Many of you will be pleased, give it a try!

If you have any question we have good news for you: our  FAQ has been updated too. If you still have questions don't hesitate to reach us!
 Twitter  Facebook   Discord
 
 Story and mood improvements 
 
Major sound and music overhaul.
 
Tablet notes with additional story elements

We have added many Tablet Notes that you can pick up, scroll, read and immerse yourselves in the demise of A-Tech Inc..
It is highly recommended to take your time and have a look at them, they enhance and color our story beyond the narration.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28133510/890fe8604f06ecceed5fd6184afa675b2aed4631.gif
Reworked narration

We can’t emphasize enough that your feedback is extremely important for us. Many of our players said that our narrator is a  bit irritating  so we reworked it and introduced a whole new character! Give it a try again, there are some surprises waiting for you!

 
 Enemies and fights 
 
New enemy

Our new enemy is called the Shotgunner – and he has a… wait for it… Shotgun! Watch out for those close encounters!

New look for zombies, multiple “levels” for enemies

This means the usual variation in hp and damage but there is something more in it.
It affects their priority: for example shooters will cull down lesser zombies now.
Zombie HP and damage reduced on easy.

Hangar fight rework (at the end of Chapter 02)

 Weapons 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28133510/a8d67ebc757c0e64b01c00d9094f7f759777ad05.gif
 
Eden Baton – new “sword-like” melee weapon

It’s much longer and deadlier than our previous melee weapons. Get ready for the chopsticks you’ve always wanted for your zombie-sushi!

Adjusted melee weapon colliders (less likely to go right through the enemy)
Gun damage adjustments

A thrown weapon’s explosion damage has been reduced to 60% of its previous value (because of the new weapon selector).
Headshot damage increased on every difficulty.

New gun handling method
 
 UX and Gameplay 
New looting method

Loot are now automatically used on pickup. This actually means that the stomach-pouch is gone for good, making the game more arcade-ish, user-friendly and intense.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28133510/881b2be8d2d473af656007d072f2ad47dd666563.gif

Achievements
A multitude of UX changes
Hard mode changes

Negative modifier for loot amount removed from Hard difficulty
Slight damage reduction for Hard difficulty.

 
 Menus 
New Inventory - Introducing the Weapon Selector menu

With the new weapon selector menu you now have a basic inventory. With every piece of ammo picked up you can spawn a weapon. Please note that only unlocked weapons can be spawned regardless of ammo. Just see the achievements for information on your unlocks. ;)
How to use it?
[olist]
	With an empty hand, Press and hold the trigger button.
	Hover over the weapon you want to use.
	Release trigger button.
	The selected weapon is spawned into the nearest holster.
[/olist]


https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28133510/1c42d3e51aefedbf2f5d85701f1938d57b9ab095.gif

notes.title: Update v0.13.2 - WMR Support!
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28133510/9c3d0cc1c2251f2517ece0ecf01b9a214447bac3.jpg

 - Disclaimer: Please note that you SHOULD NOT ALTER Windows Mixed Reality config files (e.g. default.vrsettings) because if you do and move with that configuration the game might break logically. - 

Hi,

It is here at last! After a long struggle with the sad state of the European VR economy and our local customs department we've finally been able to get our hands on a WMR headset. A quick (and painful) engine upgrade later we can now say that our game officially supports WMR headsets.

We've also fixed our latest update (v0.13.1) so you can also enjoy those features bug-free.

Unfortunately we have a second disclaimer that will hopefully be irrelevant to everyone but the most eagle-eyed of our players: The new Unreal Engine version is a mess. Like really-really frustratingly messy. Upgrading to it broke a LOT of things in the game, most of which are already fixed but there are a few graphical issues (these will require 1-2 weeks of our time and we didn't want to delay WMR support any more because of a few minor visual imperfections) and there could be some bugs that eluded our testing. We're trying to fix every issue in the shortest time possible, but we must ask for a little patience.

Known issues:
Game is not that beautiful as it was and will be 2 weeks from now :)
Some lights are 90 degree broken
Ammo pickups 90 degree broken
Enemy gun handling 90 degree bug
Landscape weird LOD near the end of Ch3

Thank you for your continuous support,
XReal Games

notes.title: Update v0.13.1 - Smooth Turn
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28133510/3df526db3ca281539aa73879e3c8ffc2531959fd.png

Our Anniversary Sale is still going until Thursday, but our next update is already live, containing the long awaited "Smooth Turn" option for both the Rift and the Vive along with another upgrade to the A-Tech soundscape.


Oculus controls reworked (turning)
In the options menu you can turn on/off and use the followings
-Smooth turning with right thumbstick. (This way you can teleport with pressing the right thumbstick)
-Snap turning with right thumbstick. (This way you can teleport with pressing the right thumbstick)
-Teleporting into any direction kept the same as before

HTC Vive controls reworked (turning)
In the options menu you can turn on/off and use the followings
-Smooth turning when touching right thumbstick. (This way you can teleport with pressing the right thumbstick)
-Snap turning when tapping on thumbstick left/right side. (Please note that you don’t have to press it. This way you can teleport with pressing the right thumbstick)
-Teleporting into any direction kept the same as before

Sound effect updates
We are transitioning to a fully spatial binaural audio system:
-A lot of player, enemy and gun sounds made binaural
-Chapter 03 got it’s nice ambient sounds
-Added reverb zones to story levels
-Better versions of some sound effects (e.g. barrel explosion, headshots, crystals)


We hope you'll enjoy the new features. You can look forward to our next Story Chapter coming in a few weeks! (worst case scenario:end of April)
 Chapter 4 is quite a break from our usual level design, so we're very curious about your feedback!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28133510/e8f0657709747ddfc25aa6cc5c8ac61bc1d5fd16.gif

See you in the comments,
The Devs

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28133510/1659e1e188428ef99f7c0f01801ca631b70e2fc2.png

 Hey VR Lovers, 

TLDR: 

CONTROLLER ORIENTED LOCOMOTION
Smooth turning
NEW MENU
Narration rework
Audio improvements
New enemies
Better gunplay


Watch Our new Trailer video on our Youtube Channel: 
https://youtu.be/OfKdIjL27Vg

Okay, so the game has changed A LOT. Details below.

Menu
If you liked the previous one you’ll be stunned from the new one. (Actually if you liked the previous one, something might be wrong with you). Completely new stunning visuals, more obvious level selector, completely overhauled user experience.

Gameplay
Gameplay elements now highlighted for better visibility
Lighting setups changed to make the game more understandable
Some parts of the levels were slightly change to make for a more streamlined experience

Player/controls
CONTROLLER ORIENTED LOCOMOTION added as an option
Smooth turning can be used on Oculus Rift (instead of snap turning)
On Oculus snap and smooth turning factor can be changed
Grenades can be stored on body from now on
Footsteps became material-dependent

Audio and sounds
FINALLY the sounds got some love. We know that a lot of you had problems with guns not sounding badass enough some noises were just out of place. There’s still a lot to do, but we are working on it  
Narration got blended in the atmosphere more and we also eliminated the shouting parts. Also your companion is no longer a complete asshole. 
Also narration can be completely turned off for our lone-horror fans. 

Game framework
Added automatic quality setter at first start for newcomers

Enemies
The AI has been improved somewhat (still working on it)
New fast enemy (a female :o you can bash virtual cyber-undead ladies now)
Body-headshot damage rebalance, difficulties now more accurate (hard is not nightmarish, easy is a lot easier than normal)
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28133510/3799e50d864bb8919d6207454f52724edb2d7dc1.gif

Here is the full dev Diary: 
http://steamcommunity.com/games/578210/announcements/detail/1591325606968787970

Weapons
Machine gun was nerfed damage, ammo capacity and accuracy  (just waving it around and killing everything is not our definition of fun).
Shotgun is more accurate (maybe it can be a tuned a little bit more, we’ll see)
Also, improved particles and projectiles! In the next update you’ll get all the new projectiles, in this one we could only include the pistol bullet as an example.
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28133510/355275df07a236ebf301362a18ed7c8b42c8075a.gif


Please note that unfortunately we had to drop backwards compatibility (game saves cleared) but we hope that the improved, smoother experiences of chapter 1 and 2 will compensate for this.

 And We made our Discord Channel! 
http://steamcommunity.com/games/578210/announcements/detail/1670142401205352462
If you have a good idea or any suggestion please don't hesitate to send us a
message. Your feedback is very welcome and by giving your input you also
become a part of the development process! :)

Thanks for all your feedback!

See you soon,
Xreal Team

notes.title: UPDATE - Story Mode Chapter 02 - 2017.12.14.
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28133510/a01d861647122fbf956129993fa4856746c0077a.jpg

We also made a couple other improvements & fixes, here’s the full changelog:

Updates to  A-Tech Cybernetic have been released. The updates will be applied automatically when your Steam client (in on-line mode) is restarted.

These changes affect the Early Access game and the Free Demo build too.

Watch Our Chapter 02 Trailer on our Youtube Channel: 
https://youtu.be/g9kiFv_BJ9w

Update v0.8.4.3

Sorry for the long silence, we grabbed a little more than we could handle at the time. But here’s the list: 


Complete narration overhaul
Complete Zombie AI and animation overhaul
Melee overhaul
A new chapter of adventures
Swarm mode updates
Literally thousands of bugs fixed (and several dozen more bugs features generated as side effect) 
Even more linear gameplay (we never thought that this might be a good thing) 
Optimization tweaks, the game should even run below the minimal hardware
Additional sounds in many places
Graphics improvement all around
Checkpoint system, save and load options


http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28133510/2d43e1f217330110fd3121aa3c2055272a0a018a.jpg

Details

Chapter 1

We completely ditched the previous narrative, both the voice acting and the story. Yaaaay. [strike](Sorry guys who actually liked it)[/strike].Now it contains strong language, so faint hearted beware! 
Removed the “flashback” scene. It made no sense.
Added a new introduction period where you gradually get access to the features of the game. 
Added some hand-holding to the first corridor (“what the hell am I supposed to do”) 
Serious (according to our GFX team, go see for yourself) graphical improvements to the main chamber.
Overall removed every obstacle from the main path, you can play using only locomotion (some areas are still only accessible with teleport but they aren’t needed for the story) 
Removed many “where the f.ck did these come from” moments 
No more facetearing maniacs running from the rooms that merge with your body because they are so fast. 
Somewhat improved loot, more HP in the later stages of the map. (and overall more LEWT) 
Improved pathing and corridor layout (You won’t stuck on everything, maybe only on every 2nd or 3rd object. 
The Network (the matrix-thingy) drops you out automatically after completing the task. Which is now much more obvious. 
Object clipping, like lights and fires is fixed 



http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28133510/723215a1ba7c33c3c86cc04d8768444e2f50437b.jpg

Chapter 2
It’s finally implemented. We won’t go into details because explore it for yourself, but we can tell you it was seriously reworked based on your feedback. When you find ways to break it please message us and we will include your name in the next patch notes (Eternal fame, infinite money etc. might come with it).

 Enemies  

A massive all around rework. Basically everything changed. 
Noticeably stronger enemies. Much more HP and damage (even if you play on “tea party” difficulty you might notice it).
Body shots do way less damage than headshots. 
Their animations are more responsive, they react if you hit them. 
Improved AI and overall behavior (no more running in one place) 
Sometimes sneaking is an option (to a certain degree) 
Melee improvements. You have to hit them properly to do damage, melee weapons are OP AF. You might throw the enemies across the room with a proper hit. But if you let them come close, you can get overwhelmed in mere seconds. High risk, high reward. 
If you just b.tchslap them they might collapse but they will get back up and get revenge for the offense. 
Brute (the big chubby guy) is much more durable now, acts like the tank he is. 
The shooter enemy is much more dangerous now, take cover. 
The fast enemy is tearing you to pieces in a few seconds. 
New teleport effect on the teleporting enemy



http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28133510/2d41bf8d93ba5f4d5561c9c30e0d541942e538f7.jpg

Objects 

Fire now damages properly and much deadlier now
HP station recharge is gradual and the total amount is increased
HP pickup health restore reduced from 50 to 20
Armor pickup armor given reduced from 50 to 25
Door opening panels are now much more consistent in both behavior and visuals
Multiple objects received new interaction sound
Force pull is now twice as fast
Keycards open the door consistently
Everything gameplay related (crates, drawers etc.)  is now colored yellow, and has a distinctive lighting method
Everything that is not related and was yellow before was recolored to grey




On the Store page, you'll find the Download Demo button here (scrolling down, in the right sidebar):

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28133510/ca617f85f589672676891cbd32f9e294f00723f8.jpg

Let the feedback flow in again, we’re counting on you to tell us if it’s pure gold or real shit what we’ve just made - or something in between

notes.title: UPDATE - New SWARM Map - 2017.10.27 + Changelog
notes.notes:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3e2uZjCwasM

Hello yo,

Play the new SWARM map, the Command Center today! How long can you survive? In addition to the already existing 3 swarm maps, now you can put yourself to the test on a 4th map in A-Tech Cybernetic’s SWARM mode. We hope you’ll have a blast with it!

We also made a couple other improvements & fixes, here’s the full changelog:

Updates to A-Tech Cybernetic have been released. The updates will be applied automatically when your Steam client (in on-line mode) is restarted.

These changes affect the Early Access game and the Free Demo build too.

Highlights:

NEW SWARM Map: the Command Center
Music player revamp: now it’s correctly changing preparation and action music loops creating infinite music, yey!


Additional fixes / improvements:

Meelee weapons are now hitting enemies more precisely
Minor fixes in narrations and subtitles


SWARM mode specific “after death” updates:
You know it’s very soon Halloween and all, a proper death is now very important ;)

The music now stops when you die
For a more convenient use, the Death menu now always faces the player
After death, you will now face the scoretable
After death, the teleport locations are fixed for the scoretable
Enemies won't attack you after you die - well, that’s something ey? At least you can rest in peace :slightly_smiling_face:
Music and sounds now clearly indicate the end of the waves


More content are coming soon, with our next update we plan to expand the story mode, so stay tuned!

Let the feedback flow in again, we’re counting on you to tell us if it’s pure gold or real shit what we’ve just made - or something in between

notes.title: UPDATE - 2017.10.21 - Changelog
notes.notes:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jPoPwZxNs8c
Updates to A-Tech Cybernetic have been released. The updates will be applied automatically when your Steam client (in on-line mode) is restarted.

These changes affect the Early Access game and the Free Demo build too.

Highlights:

Chapter 01 gameplay improvements, additional VR focused interactions
Off-limits restrictions: when leaving the playable area the player is teleported back to a valid location. E.g. from now on you can't take a peek through closed doors or walls.
Oculus Touch players can now turn in +/-45 degrees for a more comfortable standing experience


Additional / detailed improvements:

Added recoil animation for weapons
Subtitles and music can be turned on/off in the options menu
The screen percentage in the options manu can now be upscaled to 2x instead of just 1.5x - please bear in mind that it requires a very strong rig to use this option, if you find your game stuttering, please lower this option
Added informative UI messages when activating pickups
Door opening panels are now more user friendly: showing also the unavailable state, and now they are more responsive to activation
Levers are now more comfortable to use, they feel and sound better
Added a reload indicator beam, to help clarify where and how you can reload your weapons when the mags are empty
Graphically improved the portal spheres and the energy shields to make the text on them more legible
Improved weapon indicator effects
Hell of other bugfixes ;)

More maps and improvements are coming soon, stay tuned!

We're counting on your continued feedback! Keep it coming - always :)

notes.title: UPDATE - Story Mode and Swarm Mode - 2017.10.08
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28133510/85dff3418d942e44c73cb4ad471308ae3be39308.jpg

Updates to A-Tech Cybernetic have been released. The updates will be applied automatically when your Steam client (in on-line mode) is restarted.

These changes affect the Early Access game and the Free Demo build too.

General fixes & updates

Improved the Menu Tutorial (ingame tutorial will also be reworked, but in a later update)
Graphics optimizations
Fixed the blurry issue by improving Anti-aliasing - added a screen percentage slider (~SS slider) to the options -  now the game has more clear visuals
Meelee weapons and flashlight can now be holstered
Improved UI - you’ll get more information now from the UI


Story Mode specific fixes & updates

A narrative cutscene is now added to the beginning of Story Mode Chapter 01
There’s more loot to find now in Story Mode Chapter 01
Navigation (locomotion) improvements - now you can move more smoothly without getting stuck at places
Graphical fixes on the door opening panels
Added more directional texts to make it easier to find your way
Interactive items / gameplay elements are now marked with green to be more noticable
Flashlight light/shadows fixed on every quality level (there were issues with the flashlight not working on medium quality level before)
Optimizations in level streaming
Swinging melee weapons properly now deals more damage than just barely moving your hands - no more cat-fights :)
More precise weapon realoading (when overlapping with holster)
Force pull improvements (can't force pull from holster, can force pull through holstered weapons)
Interactive elements can now be grabbed/pulled with trigger
Added subtitles background for easier readability
Other minor bugfixes

More Story Mode updates will follow continuously - stay tuned :)


Guns blazing update for the Swarm Mode ;)

Did you find the swarm mode meh? Bang, bang, bang and everyone dead? NO MORE!
Spawn system reworked! Even on easier difficulties, you get to be overwhelmed easily if you don’t pay attention. On Nightmare, it literally is nightmare. Prepare your a… khmm, prepare yourself!
Weapons buffed! You get to fire away like crazy now. Weapon mags are increased by 30-100% so you no longer need to worry about reloading. Speaking of which:
Wepxplosions!  Some of you missed reloading in swarm mode, and felt sorry for their beloved instrument of death once it run dry. Stop it now! Throw your empty weapons into the mutant’s faces and watch them explode into bloody chunks. Delightful, isn’t it?
Weapon spawn times drastically reduced! Combine this with the previous points and calculate the ridiculous amount of bullets flying with explosions in the background.
Map reworks! Missed strategic layouts on the maps, hated running around? Now you can hate running around without missing anything! Teleport over obstacles, laugh at the stupid mutants while they try to get around before you shoot them to pieces!
Pickup spawners! Bad news for haters, running around and collecting health, armor and bullet time actually makes sense now! Stay alive longer or get yourself into horribly bad situations while trying to survive!
Music! It’s such a big deal, huh? Nah, it isn’t. But we finally worked it out!
Hidden stuff and loot! Look around carefully and you can find some free guns laying around. MOOOAR BULLETS AND EXPLOSIONS!
Reduced wait times between waves! You don’t need that much time to take a few guns, don’t you?
Removed barrel-placement phase! We don’t even know why was it in the game at all. Barrels now spawn automatically, eager to blow your enemies up. Or you. They don’t really care, believe me.
Somewhat improved enemy AI. Yes, they are still not the smartest guys on Earth, but well, what do you expect from some mutants who are the result of a science experiment gone awry?

More maps and improvements coming soon, stay tuned!

We're counting on your continued feedback! Keep it coming :)

notes.title: UPDATE #6 - New Map, Bossfight, Swarm Mode Changes
notes.notes:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=edoJwEp1wJE

 A-Tech Cybernetic has reached a new milestone! 

Swarm mode has been enlarged with a brand-new map the most exciting, spectacular and fearful 'Cave'.

The new map would mean nothing with just the ordinary stuff. Along with the new visuals a new boss has also arrived: the Brute.

What is more different lighting scenarios were added for every difficulty level to let you feel the stakes of your actions!

The dynamics of the game has leveled up with the appearance of a new ’weapons for points’ mechanism. You can't just take a gun off the walls anymore but with having to count all your in-game points, you have to be more tactical. You have to pay more attention to all the details!

All the doors can be locked now, so don’t forget to take advantage of this new feature to get some breathing space (and some valuable points) in the aciton packed thriller! 


Highlights:
- New level: Cave
- New enemy: Brute (boss-type)
- Money system (get for killing, spend for guns)
- Closable zombie doors
- Gamedesign became more colorful, more balanced
- Optimizations
 
Minor additions:
- A lot of bugfixes
- Enemy animations improved
- More distinct difficulty levels (with different light scenarios)
- Game state messages
- Tutorials expanded
- Graphical tweaks, new effects added
